'''2010 Malastare Regionals Rob Montgomery DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rob Montgomery]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Carbon Chamber Testing / Favorite Decoration
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
